answer.rationale: Immediate competitive threat to SMB base warrants rapid response grounded in proven lever. memory_73 confirms targeted promotional pricing is effective for price-sensitive SMB segments with acquisition and revenue lift. This directly addresses the churn spike from competitor price cuts. A standard_experiment scale allows defensive pricing response without full-margin erosion across the customer base. Risk flagged: aggressive pricing may compress long-term margin health and could signal weakness to other segments; however, losing price-sensitive SMB accounts to churn carries equal or greater lifetime-value risk. Activation_messaging (memory_91) and onboarding simplification (memory_31, exp_31) are lower-friction, complementary longer-term plays, but insufficient alone against acute pricing pressure. Enterprise_sales_assist does not address SMB churn. Referral_incentive (memory_57) requires baseline retention. Preserving uncertainty: competitive landscape may shift further; pricing response can be calibrated based on churn deceleration within 2 weeks. Standard scale allows iteration before broader rollout.
